title: Data Analyst
description:
Your new company
You'll be joining a leading international bank in the City of London. You'll sit in its Payments team, which supports the bank's day-to-day operations and works closely with teams across the business.

Your new role
As a Data Analyst in the Payments & Data Solutions team, you'll use data, reporting and automation to make the department more efficient.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building reports and dashboards from scratch, working from requirements gathered across different stakeholders
  • Pulling, checking and analysing data from internal systems with SQL and Python
  • Developing and maintaining Excel-based reporting tools
  • Supporting automation, including monitoring RPA processes and investigating exceptions
  • Finding ways to improve processes and automate manual tasks
  • Assessing how system enhancements and regulatory changes affect the business, and gathering requirements
  • Supporting project governance with trackers, action logs and management reporting
  • Working with Technology, Operations, Risk and external stakeholders from requirements through to testing and implementation


What you'll need to succeed
Essential:

  • A degree in a subject such as Business, Finance, Economics or Information Systems
  • Experience in financial services
  • Commercial experience with SQL and Python
  • Experience building reports end to end with business users
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas and pivot tables)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with good attention to detail
  • Good communication skills and a flexible approach to changing priorities

    Highly desirable:
  • Payments experience, ideally including SWIFT / ISO 20022
  • Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate or VBA
  • Exposure to RPA, process improvement or digital transformation projects


What you'll get in return

  • Bonus & benefits package
  • Hybrid working
